Looking at the `pickLevel()` function in `engine/src/retrieval/router.ts` (lines 337–358), the threshold was **narrowed from `<=5` to `<=2` tokens**.

The comment explains the regression that prompted this fix:

> Narrowed from <=5 to <=2 tokens: short natural-language queries (3-5 tokens, e.g. "how does auth work") were being routed to keyword-only L2 and never reaching semantic search. Keep this narrow — only true keyword/tag lookups (1-2 tokens) stay pure-L2.

**The problem:** Queries with 3–5 tokens (like "how does auth work") were stuck in pure keyword-only L2 lookup, missing semantic recall entirely.

**The fix:** Now only truly short lookups (1–2 tokens) go to pure L2; anything with 3–15 tokens routes through the hybrid L2_L3_HYBRID path, which fuses keyword search with bi-encoder semantic search via RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion).
